entries.7170bf100edefb7f: A single-segment business engaged in the manufacture and sale of centerless grinders (centerless grinding machines) and internal grinders (internal grinding machines), and their peripheral equipment. The company carries out development, design, manufacturing, sales and after-sales service on an integrated basis, and its local subsidiaries in the United States, Thailand and China sell products and parts in their respective regions. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥5,782 million. Main locations are the head office and factory in Yamagata City, Yamagata Prefecture, and the Miharashi Factory and R&D Center in Kaminoyama City, along with the Tokyo Sales Office and the Chubu Satellite (Nagoya Sales Office).

entries.b29c6db279365846: Centerless grinders and internal grinders. Centerless grinders are machine tools that machine the outer surfaces of mainly round bar and ring-shaped workpieces through three-point support by a grinding wheel, a regulating wheel and a blade. Internal grinders are machine tools that machine the inner surfaces of mainly cylindrical and ring-shaped workpieces using a relatively small-diameter grinding wheel. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended August 2025 were ¥4,592 million.
